Sri Lanka Electorate Boundaries

Source: R/Data.R
SLElectorate.Rd

Spatial polygon boundaries for the 160 electorates (polling divisions) across the 22 electoral districts of Sri Lanka.

Usage

SLElectorate

Format

An sf object with 160 rows and 5 columns:

ElecCode

Electoral electorate code.

District

Electoral district name.

Electorate

Standardised electorate (polling division) name.

OrigName

Original name in the spatial dataset.

geometry

Spatial polygon geometry.

Source

https://github.com/nuuuwan/sl-topojson

Details

Electorates names have been standardised using the 2024 Sri Lankan presidential election dataset. The original names from the spatial source are retained.
